product.name: Angara GenAI Agent
product.tagline: From Jira story to proven suite, code-reviewed MRs, and browser runs — in one agent loop.
product.sub: Not a chatbot that invents steps. Grounded in the ticket, the diff, and your knowledge packs — then scored before a human saves.
product.disclaimer: Interactive sample with frozen data — illustrates product power for evaluation.

painVsUs.title: Why normal tools fall short
painVsUs.subtitle: Most teams stitch chatbots, spreadsheets, and a TMS. We close the loop.

rows.themDetail: Pretty cases, weak grounding. Invents ZIPs, routes, copy. No proof against AC.
rows.usDetail: R ids from the ticket before the diff. Cases must prove expected results — coverage is checked, not assumed.

rows.themDetail: Great library. Still hand-authored. No MR awareness. No AI quality bar.
rows.usDetail: Author at change speed, publish Test Sets / Executions, sync statuses — reporter is a real person when resolvable.

rows.themDetail: Findings sit in a tab. Never become tests. Ports re-reviewed three times.
rows.usDetail: Every live MR in one run. Shared diffs once. Confirmed bugs become F items the suite must prove.

rows.themDetail: Break on every UI shift. No NL path. No human gate on bugs.
rows.usDetail: Natural language on a real browser, or plain-English → Playwright with self-heal. Bugs stay human-gated.

rows.themDetail: One prompt, one list of cases. No dedupe science. No house cases. No cost/trace.
rows.usDetail: 7-param gate, semantic merge with coverage guard, OOB house cases, MCP skills, PageSpeed/SEO beside functional QA.

agents.name: TEST CASE Generate
agents.blurb: Jira + MR → grounded cases. Ledger, coverage proof, dedupe, quality gate. CR in parallel.
bullets: Ticket-first ledger — assert requirements, not whatever the code shipped
Full coverage: every checklist item proven in expected results
House / out-of-the-box cases every storefront suite must carry
Weakest quality parameter caps the score — no hiding weak dedup

agents.name: Multi-MR Code Review
agents.blurb: Principal-engineer review on every loaded live MR in the same generate run.
bullets: Whole logic + call sites — not 900-character hunks alone
Store scope & locale parity enforced in code
Identical diffs across MRs reviewed once, tagged per MR
Accept/Deny gates Save; F items still feed generation
agents.sample: Primary + Region + Theme · F1/F2 on checklist

agents.name: CUA Browser Agent
agents.blurb: Natural-language browser tests on a real site. Failures wait for a human — never auto-spam Jira.
bullets: From URL, Jira case, or batch
Element inspect, transfer sizes, device rules
Merge same-setup read-only cases into one cheaper run
Lessons from approved tester reviews only

ticket.summary: FedEx Pickup location at checkout — US storefront
acceptanceCriteria: Guest and signed-in shoppers can search FedEx Pickup by ZIP on checkout shipping step
Selecting a location shows name, address, distance, and hours
Place Order stays disabled until a location is chosen when Pickup is selected
Billing address is still required and is not overwritten by the pickup location
Change limited to US storefront only — UK/AU unchanged
ticket.qaNote: Only checkout shipping + Place Order. No cart, PDP, or tracking cases.

bugs.title: Pickup UI reachable without US store guard
bugs.problem: Component mounts whenever method=pickup; ticket limits change to US.

byMr.label: Region

bugs.title: Same pickup change present on region fork
bugs.problem: Port carries US-scoped feature into a fork outside ticket scope. Copied from Primary — store-scope never auto-cleared.

byMr.note: Same normalized diff as Primary — reviewed once there; findings tagged onto this MR.

byMr.label: Theme
byMr.note: Third live MR in the same ticket. Identical shared files skipped; locale + conflict checks still ran per MR.

codeReview.generationLink: Multi-MR: every loaded live MR reviewed in one run. Shared defects fold to one F line naming every MR. Log-only findings never become cases.

qualityGate.note: Pass = every parameter ≥ 70/100. Weakest parameter caps overall — a strong AC score cannot hide weak dedup.

findings.issue: One Explore journey restated a ledger item almost verbatim.

merges.kept: #7 ZIP search returns nearby FedEx locations
folded: #19 Search pickup by postal code shows results
#31 Nearby facilities list after ZIP enter
merges.why: Same setup, same outcome — reworded twins. Steps/tags/sources folded into keeper.

merges.kept: #12 Place Order disabled until pickup chosen
folded: #28 Cannot submit with Pickup and no location

dedupe.guard: After each merge, coverage re-check. A merge that leaves an item unproven is undone — dedupe never costs coverage.

cua.title: CUA executes the suite
cua.intent: On US checkout, select FedEx Pickup, search ZIP 10001, choose first location, confirm Place Order enables after billing.
steps: Assert Place Order enabled with billing complete
cua.note: Fail → awaiting_review. Human files bug or marks test_problem. Never auto-Jira.

jira.title: Publish to Xray
items: Reporter = signed-in QA when Jira can resolve them

talkingPoints: One platform — author, multi-MR review, quality gate, browser run, Xray — not five disconnected tools.
Grounded generation: ticket ledger first, coverage proven, invented values flagged.
Code review findings become tests in the same run.
Dedupe merges repeats; coverage guard refuses merges that would drop proof.
Humans stay in the loop on Save and on bug filing.
